event_op_gang_war_news: Gang war In The Lower Levels!
event_op_gang_war_desc: Rival gangs has declared war on each other! Shootouts and skirmishes have erupted across the Lower Levels. Expect increased demand for Medical Supplies.
event_op_weapon_shipment_desc: A large shipment of illegal weapons has slipped past Security patrols and entered the Lower Levels. Expect a surge in weapon availability and drop in prices.
event_op_mob_secret_desc: Reports indicate a minor surge in demands for weapons from secret buyers all over the Lower Levels.
event_op_mobilization_desc: Major revolution activities have been detected in the Lower Levels. Revolution cells are making final preparations for a major operation. Expected Weapon, Medical Supplies and Armor prices to surge.
event_op_raid_upper_desc: Revolutionaries have launched daring raids in the Upper Levels. Looting goods from homes and businesses to sell in the Lower Levels to fund their operations. Expected increase supply for Household Goods
event_op_raid_sec_desc: Revolutionaries have ambushed a major Lower Levels Security outpost. The clashes have led to losses on both sides along with Lower Levels Citizens caught in the crossfire, driving up demand for medical supplies and weakening Security influence.
event_op_patrols_desc: Security has temporarily expanded patrols and set up new checkpoints across the Lower Levels. Some Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed, brining back some order in the Lower Levels.
event_op_crackdown_desc: In response to growing concerns over the rise in black market activity and the influx of illegal goods across the station, Command has announced a comprehensive crackdown on contraband. Effective immediately, the enforcement of stricter inspections will be implemented across all sectors.
event_op_raid_bm_desc: Security forces launched a surprise raid on black market hubs. Large amount of weapon and narcotic were seized, disrupting illegal trade.
event_op_raid_rev_desc: Security has raided a uncovered revolutionary safehouse. The arrests and confiscations has weaken the revolution.
event_op_martial_law_desc: Due to recent events, Martial law has been declared across the Lower Levels. Curfews, checkpoints, and surveillance blanket the district. Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed.
event_op_budget_increase_desc: Command allocates a major budget increase to Security, allowing additional operations to be launched.
event_op_riot_desc: Due to recent event, crowds of Lower Levels citizens erupt into violent riots across the Lower Levels. Shops are looted, Security outposts attacked, and chaos spreads quickly. Food and Weapon are in high demands.
event_op_worker_strike_desc: Due to recent events, disgruntled Lower Level workers have gone on strike. Food and water supplies are being disrupted.
event_op_medical_aid_desc: Upper Level charities have gather additional medical staff and supplies to the Lower Levels. While some residents remain skeptical, the effort reduces unrest.
event_op_food_drive_desc: In a rare gesture of goodwill, Command has distributed rations and food packages across Lower Levels neighborhoods. The initiative eases tensions but some view it as a propaganda tactic.
event_op_household_relief_desc: A charity in the Upper Levels has made a generous donation of essential Household Goods to Lower Levels residents. While some remain skeptical of the motives, the aid should helps improve living conditions and settle any growing unrest.
event_lottery_draw_desc: {0} is the winning number! Redeem your ticket with your lottery representative! If you have at least 3 matching digits, you win a prize! Good Luck!
event_wanted3_desc: In a swift operation by station security, Arthur Lafleur, a known activist and part of the former leadership in the failed revolution attempts of the lower levels, has been apprehended.
event_evidence_locker_desc: A daring break-in at the Station's Central Evidence Locker has left Security scrambling. Reports indicate that a crate of confiscated contraband, including key evidence in an active investigation, has gone missing. Security have warned the citizens of the Lower Levels to keep an eye out for suspicious goods entering circulation.
event_cosmetic_all_quiet_news: All Quiet In The Lower Levels
event_cosmetic_all_quiet_desc: The Lower Levels have been unusually quiet today, with no major incidents to report. Markets are stable and residents are going about their daily lives.
event_cosmetic_electrical_desc: The Upper Levels will experience a temporary blackout as planned electrical maintenance work gets underway.
event_cosmetic_nutrifruit_desc: A collective of Lower Levels maintenance technicians have developed a low-cost hydroponic system capable of producing small but consistent batches of Nutrifruit.
event_cosmetic_peat_news: How Much Meat Is Actually In PEAT?
event_cosmetic_peat_desc: PEAT, the canned processed meat found in nearly every kitchen in the Lower Levels, is under scrutiny. Independent researchers are questioning how much of the product is actually meat.
event_cosmetic_recycling_desc: A small recycling awareness campaign has been launched on the mid-levels to encourage proper waste disposal. The campaign is expected to have minimal practical impact.
event_cosmetic_artist_showcase_desc: A local artist showcase is being hosted in the Lower Levels, where residents can view and purchase artwork made from recycled station materials.
event_cosmetic_maintenance_strike_desc: A brief strike by maintenance crews has been resolved with no significant delays or damages reported. Normal operations have resumed.
event_cosmetic_tech_demo_desc: A technology exhibition has been organized on the Upper Levels, showcasing the latest innovations from startups and tech companies. Most products on display are aimed at high-end buyers.
event_cosmetic_transit_news: New Transit Line Opens on Mid-Level
event_cosmetic_transit_desc: A new transit line has opened on the mid-levels, connecting several residential districts to a commercial hub. The improved connectivity is expected to slightly ease commutes for mid-level residents.
event_cosmetic_fountain_desc: A new water fountain has been unveiled on the Upper Levels as part of an ongoing beautification project. Security has advised that any citizen caught drinking from the fountain will be arrested and fined.
event_cosmetic_garden_desc: Lower Level residents have expanded their community garden with a few new plots for growing basic vegetables. The development is unlikely to affect Food prices.
event_cosmetic_art_contest_desc: An art contest held in a mid-level community center invited residents to submit their creations, with the best entries to be displayed in public spaces for a week.
event_cosmetic_cultural_desc: An Upper Level cultural group is holding a small celebration featuring traditional performances, music, and food. The event will be mostly attended by Upper Level residents and have little impact on the market.
event_cosmetic_spacewalk_desc: A routine spacewalk training exercise for station technicians has been successfully completed with no disruptions to station activities. One man from the Lower Levels is reportedly being treated for shock, after mistaking a spacewalker for an alien.
event_normal_nutrifruit_harvest_desc: A large Mid-Level farm is harvesting its Nutrifruit crop. Expect fresh Nutrifruit and lower Food prices for a while.
event_normal_bad_harvest_desc: A Lower Level Nutrifruit farm has had a terrible season, with crops failing due to lack of proper resources and maintenance. Expect higher Food prices and a shortage of fresh produce for a while.
event_normal_seed_heist_desc: Nutrifruit seeds from hydroponic farm storage have vanished overnight in a daring theft. Both Food and Seed costs are expected to rise sharply across the station.
event_normal_counterfeit_med_desc: A large quantity of counterfeit medical goods have been discovered across various clinics and hospitals. Demand for genuine medical supplies is expected to surge.
event_normal_water_breakdown_news: Breakdown At Treatment Plant Threatens Water Supply
event_normal_water_breakdown_desc: A pump failure at the central Water Treatment Plant is causing major disruption to the water supply. Security has appealed for calm, as market experts anticipate prices for Water and Water Purification Supplies to soar over the next few days.
event_normal_water_maintenance_news: Scheduled Maintenance To Proceed At Water Treatment Plant
event_normal_water_maintenance_desc: Routine maintenance at the central Water Treatment Plant will proceed on schedule, Security has announced. Disruptions to the pipeline are expected to be limited.
event_normal_ice_asteroid_desc: One of our brave mining crews have returned from a successful expedition to the ice-rich asteroid known as "Beira 41-A". Their return is expected to result in an influx of High Quality Water, and lower prices as a result.
event_normal_mob_justice_news: Mob Justice in the Lower Levels!
event_normal_mob_justice_desc: Fed up with a dishonest shopkeeper, citizens in the Lower Levels are taking justice into their own hands. Station Security have appealed for calm.
event_normal_storeroom_desc: A group of scavengers in the Lower Levels have stumbled upon a hidden room packed with household items. A high volume of goods making their way to market will likely lower prices today.
event_normal_mining_return_desc: A cohort of miners have returned from an expedition to a mineral-rich asteroid. Material prices are expected to fall for a while.
event_normal_construction_desc: Various new construction projects are springing up across the Lower Levels. Construction materials and skilled labourers are likely to be in shorter supply.
event_normal_meteor_shower_desc: A meteor shower struck the station last night, causing damage and breaches across multiple sectors. The Lower Levels, lacking a reinforced hull, suffered the most — expect material prices to rise.
event_normal_power_shortage_news: Low Power In The Lower Levels
event_normal_power_shortage_desc: A faulty power generator has caused a power outage in the Lower Levels. Expect a shortage of energy cells while repairs are underway.
event_normal_power_maintenance_desc: Routine maintenance has begun on one of the main power plants in the Lower Levels. Citizens have been told to expect minor disruptions to the power supply throughout the scheduled period.
event_normal_blackout_desc: A catastrophic failure in the central power grid has plunged the entire Station into darkness. Expect a surge in demand for energy cells and power-related products.
event_normal_cruise_ship_desc: A cruise ship has docked in the Upper Levels, unloading a wave of tourists. It is expected that some curious visitors may even wander down to the Lower Levels. Station Security has appealed for citizens to be respectful during the visit.
event_normal_oxymore_desc: A sharp increase in Oxymore use has been reported across the Station, with clinics seeing a surge in addiction and overdose cases. Expect rising demand for medical supplies and treatment services.
ins_cig_issues_with: There's an issue with the {0}. You see?
ins_cig_confront_correct: Ah yes, I see it now.
ins_cig_confront_wrong: Check again, there is nothing wrong with it.
ins_cig_georgio_didnt_know: Ah, Georgio didn't know about this.
ins_cig_georgio_everything_wrong: Everything is wrong with these cigarettes.
ins_cig_talk_genuine_deny: No, it is not. I checked it myself.
ins_stamp_confront_correct: Is there? I had no idea.
mech_end_rent_desc: As a result of failing to pay your rent, you were evicted. Abandoned by your customers, your contact, and even The Mentor, you are forced to go back to the life of a scavenger. It isn't long before the Store is rented out to somebody new, and you find yourself standing on the other side of the counter, haggling for just a few credits more.
mech_end_arrest_desc: For crimes against the station, the Security arrested you. You were locked up in the brig. While serving your sentence, your store was leased to someone else. After your release, with the store lost, you went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.
mech_end_execution_desc: For capital crimes against the station, the Security arrested and executed you. After your execution your store was leased to someone else. Your customers quickly forgot about you, and in time, there was no trace of you left on the Station.
mech_end_buyout_desc: You sign the deed, and with it, the weight of the rent vanishes, alongside the shadow of the Landlord. The shop is yours, free and clear, a hard-earned victory in a world that's never been kind. For the first time, you stand in control of your future, with nothing but your own ambition to guide you.
mech_end_buyout_mortgage_desc: You sign the final papers, and with it, the last chains that bound you to the loan shark are broken. The store is truly yours now, free from the threat of repossession, free from the shadow of the underworld. You've beaten the odds, survived the grind, and come out on top. The future is yours.
mech_end_repo_desc: It's the end of the road. The store is taken from you, and with it, everything you fought for slips through your fingers. The loan shark's cold grip tightens as the walls close in, leaving you bankrupt, homeless, and with nothing but a bitter reminder of how quickly everything can be lost in this unforgiving world.
mech_end_mob_desc: After one too many offences against the Lower Levels, a mob of angry customers stormed your store. They took everything you owned and you were thrown out of the airlock. This is justice in the Lower Levels.
mech_end_sec_desc: Arrested by the Security on some trumped up charges, you were thrown in the brig. The store was seized and sold to pay for a large fine. You were released after a few weeks, but the store was long gone. You went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.
mech_end_hitman_desc: After one too many offences against the Upper Levels, a hitman was contracted by the elites of the station to take you out for good.
mech_end_sentinel_desc: After skipping one too many Immunivax injectors, your faulty immune system turned on your own body. It wasn't an illness that killed you, it was yourself.
mech_end_bombed_desc: After being declared as an enemy of the Revolution, a bomb was planted in your store. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you. The ruin of your store served as a warning to others who would dare to oppose the Revolution.
mech_end_cartel_retired_desc: The Cartel decided that you were no longer worth keeping around. You were retired from the business.
mech_end_vendor_permit_desc: You weren't able to secure a vendor permit and were forced to close your store.
afterhour_items_lost_warning: Items left on the ground will be left behind, and lost. Are you sure you want to leave?
afterhour_jackson_warning: Dr. Jackson will send his assistant to retrieve any items you left on the ground. Are you sure you want to leave?
afterhour_attempts_wounded: Attempts Remaining: Can't scavenge while wounded!
mech_gutterflow_tap: The water line is currently connected to the sewer.
mech_rustwater_tap: The water line is currently connected to the industrial discharge pipe.
request_meteor_ll_desc: The meteor shower breached a number of areas in the Lower Levels. We have closed down adjacent areas and started repairs on the breaches, but progress has been slow due to lack of supplies.
request_meteor_ul_desc: The Upper Levels Community pool was damaged during the meteor shower. It was due for renovation anyway. We are interested in buying a crate of engineering supplies to speed up the process.
request_medshortage_ll_title: Medical Supply For Lower Levels Charity Clinic
request_medshortage_ll_desc: We are out of medical supplies. Shortages have left many without proper treatment. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
request_medshortage_ul_title: Medical Supply For Upper Levels General Hospital
request_medshortage_ul_desc: We are experiencing delays in receiving critical medical supplies. While we still have stock, we are willing to pay a premium to ensure our reserves remain well-stocked.
request_medshortage_bm_desc: With the ongoing shortage, we are buying up all the supply to drive up the price even higher! Get us the supply and we will pay you handsomely.
request_ll_construction_desc: A new housing block is under construction in the Lower Levels, but securing materials has been a challenge. We need supplies to keep the project moving forward.
request_bm_construction_desc: The demand for construction materials is rising, and we intend to make sure we control the supply. Get us the supplies before the others do and we'll pay well.
request_ll_soup_kitchen_title: Supplies for Lower Level Soup Kitchen
request_ll_soup_kitchen_desc: The recent events have left many in need. We can't pay much, but we will make sure to let everyone know of your kindness.
request_sec_evidence_desc: A crate of important evidence has gone missing. We need it back ASAP, no questions asked. Deliver it quickly, and you'll be compensated accordingly.
request_sec_evidence_requester: Head of Security for Lower Levels
request_bm_evidence_desc: A recently stolen crate of evidence contains damaging information against my client. We are willing to pay a premium to secure it before it falls back into Security's hands or worse.
request_rev_oxymore_desc: Need some refreshment for our friend's birthday party. It's last-minute.
request_rev_scrap_desc: We need scrap metal to build a new garden. The old one's decrepit.
request_rev_seccard_desc: We need a housewarming gift for an upcoming friend's gathering.
request_rev_peat_desc: We are stocking up our garden for a picnic and need non-perishables. Processed meat is ideal.
request_ul_rare_desc: One of our clients has requested this. We will pay well for it.
request_ul_charity_desc: We are collecting items for charity to help those in need in the Lower Levels. Any contribution would be greatly appreciated.
request_lower_worker_desc: Need something to survive those long shifts.
request_georgio_tp_desc: Georgio needs toilet paper for his collection.
request_butcher_cleaver_desc: Need a new cleaver. Old one is dull.
request_sawyer_beer_desc: My crew's been grinding hard. Time to kick back. Get me some Red Imp Beers.
request_lun_snackbar_desc: My favorite snack bar is sold out everywhere. Get me a couple. I'll pay well.
request_sawyer_crowbar_desc: Someone has been doing their own cleaning without our permission. We will make an example out of them.
request_jackson_energy_desc: Need some energy drinks to stay awake. Gotta finish my experiments!
request_landlord_special1_desc: One of my tenants keeps asking me to repair his door. Just get me some scrap metal and I'll see what I can do.
request_landlord_special2_desc: An annoying tenant keeps asking me to repair their ventilation. I guess I'll just increase the rent more next week.
request_landlord_special3_desc: One of my unit's street windows got broken. I'll just patch it up with some cloth.
request_lun_retirement_desc: We are pitching in to get Officer Boucher a nice BBQ party for his retirement.
request_upper_petmeat_desc: Acquire some real raw meat, fresh and unprocessed. Only the best for my pet.
request_mother_galaxy_desc: I can't believe that Galaxy Blend is the only decent food nutritious enough for a baby around the Lower Levels. Help me get some.
water_higher_player: Huh... The water purity is actually higher!
water_higher_client: Wow, thanks for letting me know.
water_rust_player: This is Rustwater. I can see the particles in the water.
water_rust_client: So? Fine, I'll lower the price.
water_gutter_player: This is clearly Gutterflow. It's brown, see?
water_ghost_player: This is Ghostwater. It's hard to tell, can't be too careful.
water_ghost_client: Really? I'll lower the price, then.
water_base_player: This is Basewater. Are you trying to pull a fast one or what?
water_wrong_pure: I don't have the Credits for Pure Water.
water_wrong_rust: Are you crazy? I'm not drinking Rustwater!
water_wrong_gutter: Wow, you expect me to drink that?
appraisal_patience_1: You clearly don't know what you are doing.

appraisal_accept_bit_lower: A bit lower than I expected.
appraisal_accept_bit_higher: A bit higher than I expected.
husbandry_cage_desc: A small cage for housing animals. Doesn't look particularly comfortable, but probably nicer than what some people have in the Lower Levels.
husbandry_cage_expand_hint: [Use Metal Ingot to Expand ({0} upgrade(s) remaining)]
note_ghostwater_threat_1: Stop selling that bogus water, you are killing us!
note_ghostwater_threat_2: We know what you did. Stop the water scam, NOW!
note_ghostwater_threat_3: Keep on selling tainted water, and you'll regret it.
note_ghostwater_threat_4: How do you sleep when you are selling Ghostwater as drinking water?
note_ghostwater_threat_5: Stop the Ghostwater scam, or we'll stop you ourselves.
note_ghostwater_threat_6: Your fake water is killing us. You're next.
note_ammo_threat_1: Your ammo almost got me killed.
note_admirer_1: Every day I pass by your shop... one day I'll have the courage to say hello.
note_admirer_2: You don't know me, but I know everything about you. Keep being you.
note_admirer_3: I left something for you. Just a small token of... appreciation.
note_admirer_4: I wonder if you ever notice me watching from the shadows...
note_admirer_5: You make the Lower Levels feel a little brighter.
note_admirer_6: You're the only reason I come here anymore. Stay safe.
note_admirer_7: To my favorite shopkeeper, don't forget to smile today.

note_li_formula_s1_body: - Blend a few Dream Caps to get Dream Cap Mush
note_li_formula_s2_body:
- Add Alcohol equal to 5 times the volume of Dream Cap Mush
- Heat the mixture to 40-50C to get Dream Cap Extract
note_li_formula_s3_body:
- Filter with a Kotton Fabric, then use the Evaporator
- (REQUIRED) All water and alcohol are evaporated
note_li_formula_s4_body:
- Add Reducing Agent equal to the Dream Cap Extract
- Add Lipobond Agent equal to a quarter of it
- Heat the mixture to 45-55C to get Nomore
note_li_formula_s4_note: WARNING: DREAM CAP EXTRACT WILL DEGRADE ABOVE 60C
note_li_formula_s5_body:
- Filter again and evaporate the Lipobond Agent
- Select Nomore Injector in the Chem Finisher

event_serpico_dead_news: Security Officer Found Dead in the Dumping Ground
event_serpico_dead_desc: Cadet Serpico, who was under investigation on corruption charges, was found dead in the Dumping Ground. The Security Department has given no further details at this time.

mech_end_lou_debt_desc: You couldn't pay what you owed Lou, so she settled the score her own way: a little present on your counter, and this one was real. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you.
event_lou_admiral_desc: A visiting Republic admiral and his escort were gunned down near the docking bays last night. Witnesses say the shooter, a blonde woman in a stolen Security uniform, walked right up to the admiral's party before opening fire. Officers on the scene hit her several times, but she escaped, and no trace of her has been found.
